title: Batch Train Car Reversal
description: You are managing a freight train composed of a singly linked list of rail cars. You need to reverse the order of cars in consecutive groups of size k. If the number of remaining cars at the end is less than k, leave them in their original order. You must perform this operation by modifying the pointers of the nodes directly, without using extra memory for node values.
constraints: The number of cars in the train is in the range [1, 5000].
input_format: A head pointer to a linked list representing the train cars, and an integer k.
output_format: The head pointer to the modified linked list.

examples.explanation: The first group [1, 2] is reversed to [2, 1]. The second group [3, 4] is reversed to [4, 3]. The remaining car [5] stays as is.
The first group [1, 2, 3] is reversed to [3, 2, 1]. The remaining cars [4, 5] are fewer than 3, so their order is unchanged.
Groups of size 1 mean no elements are swapped.
